Summarize a benchmark log comparing an LSH pipeline ('lsh') against a naive all-pairs baseline ('naive'). The measurements come from this bundled log, written out in full below; each run is {run_id, method, corpus_size, status, wall_ms, peak_mb, tokens}. Build one row per corpus size that appears anywhere in the log, failed runs included, sorted by corpus_size ascending. Only runs with status 'ok' count. For each (corpus_size, method) group, runs is the number of ok runs. If runs >= min_runs, each metric's median is the lower median: sort that metric's ok values ascending and take the value at index (n-1)//2 (sort each metric separately); otherwise wall_ms, peak_mb and tokens are null. speedup_pct is (200 * naive_wall + lsh_wall) // (2 * lsh_wall) using the two median wall_ms (i.e. 100*naive/lsh rounded half up), null unless both methods have medians. lsh_wins is true only if both methods have medians and lsh's median is strictly lower on all three metrics. Copy dataset and min_runs unchanged. The log's runs are:
